authoringInitial.qualification: Preceded child-allocator/reservation refinement; final aggregate covers the retained source.

pairedConstruction.protocol: Five independently launched alternating paired windows; each executable uses three warmups and nine samples per size. Source-construction timings only; no World timing gate. Builds stopped before measurement.

interpretation: Binding/list construction is retained. Array relocations count actual old lengths when backing pointers change; each primitive operand pair is separately copied once. Typed materialization emits 4N-1 terms and 4N+1 values for this two-statement emitter, with exactly N native emitter calls.

Original distinct-literal and row membership visits are reconstructed from the actual input catalogs and the original explicit loops; they are not instrumented optimized-loop counters. Distinct literal lookup remains quadratic and is not claimed fixed. Its mutable table semantics are guarded by a new regression.

The sorted-row implementation checks order once and performs two monotone merges. Each merge advances a left or right cursor and writes at most one output per left occurrence/right new ID. No repeated-prefix membership scan remains. Unsorted inputs additionally incur private sorting.

Named declaration/argument indexes require one insertion per supplied name and one lookup per declared field. Complexity is expected linear in key bytes and entries under the standard exact-key hash map; no worst-case adversarial hashing theorem is claimed. Semantic/schema checks retain their own cost.

Temporary indexes use the arena child allocator and one reservation. They are freed on return, while copied output fields and IDs remain arena-owned. Small arities pay fixed setup: in the paired observations 1–4 fields add roughly 42–84 ns to declaration/assembly; extra scratch allocation is explicit. These are Boundary construction costs under the corrected policy, not unaccepted World regressions.

Typed authoring and checked materialization are separate. compile_stage_ns is indexed by source.CompileStage: source_copy, source_check, lowering, target_check, direct_optimization, canonicalization, coalescing, semantic_optimization, complete. Phase timings are single observations, not paired claims. Capture authoring excludes the mandatory checked publication/compilation, which separately proves N retained capture fields.

Five paired windows were measured after this task’s builds stopped; no exclusive-host claim. The measurements isolate row/name operations, not whole-application speed. All 18 Agent images and all four raw/typed configuration fixture images/traces are identical to frozen P16 outputs. No new World execution cost is introduced by those equal artifacts, and no runtime speedup is claimed.
M3/P13/P16 timing decisions, later packages, final package bindings and installed serial reviews remain open.
